title: BrandGuardAIReview_v1.1
description: The official output contract for the BrandGuard AI module. Any response not adhering to this schema must be marked as Incomplete.

review_id.description: A unique UUID v4 for the specific review session.

brand_id.description: The ID of the brand being reviewed (e.g., 'VerdantCo').

status.description: Complete if all checks passed or were definitively failed. Incomplete if evidence is missing or corrections are unsafe.

human_review_required.description: Flag indicating if a human must manually sign off on this content.

incomplete_reasons.description: List of specific reasons why the review is marked Incomplete.

finding_id.description: 1-indexed unique ID for the finding within this review.

affected_text.description: The exact snippet of text that caused the violation.

rule_reference.description: The ID of the rule from the rulebook (e.g., 'Verdant_R1').

evidence_references.description: List of IDs from the Synthetic Evidence Registry (SER).

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why this is a violation.

corrected_text.description: An evidence-grounded suggested fix. Null if no safe fix exists.

human_review_required.description: Whether this specific finding requires human verification.

model_version.description: The version of the LLM and adapter used.

rulebook_version.description: The version of the brand rulebook applied.
